capabilities.description: Thin public bridge to the exact admitted Physlib Hamilton-equation operator.
laws: SatisfiesHamiltonEquations is exactly the zero set of ClassicalMechanics.hamiltonEqOp.
The admitted upstream `hamiltonEqOp_eq_zero_iff_hamiltons_equations` exposes the two derivative equations.

capabilities.description: Formula-locked local modal energy plus a thin positive-frequency bridge to admitted Physlib.
laws: A strictly positive-frequency mode maps to the Physlib oscillator with mass 1 and spring constant omega^2 and inherits its energy-conservation theorem.
Explicit derivative hypotheses imply scalar modal-energy conservation.
Scalar modal energy is exactly (v^2 + omegaSq*a^2)/2 and is nonnegative for a nonnegative frequency square.

capabilities.description: Formula-locked generic order-theoretic first-hit interface with the zero-time edge case excluded.
laws: If 0 < t is strictly before the first hit then the event is false at t; no infimum-attainment claim is made.
The empty event hits at top, event inclusion reverses first-hit order, and every member bounds the infimum from above.
hittingTimes is exactly the set of strictly positive event times and firstHittingTime is exactly its ENNReal infimum.

capabilities.description: Formula-locked duration-indexed persistence, kept generic rather than tied to one equipartition threshold.
laws: PersistsFor A t L is exactly universal holding throughout the closed interval [t,t+L].
The interface makes no infimum-attainment claim.
persistenceTimes is exactly the set of strictly positive starts satisfying that duration-L event, and persistenceTime is exactly its ENNReal infimum.

capabilities.description: Exact conditional rescaling for an explicitly supplied effective kinetic collision map and IVP only.
laws: Given unit-coupling and coupling-g solutions with the same initial value, an explicit ordinary IVP uniqueness hypothesis yields Dg(t) = D1(g²t).
SolvesKineticEquation takes a raw collision map, includes the common initial condition, and is exactly the derivative equation D' = g² C(D).

capabilities.description: Formula-locked pointwise mass algebra and its finite nonnegative kinetic quadratic form.
laws: Mass, inverse-mass, square-root, and inverse-square-root actions are locked to their pointwise formulas in m.mass.
The finite kinetic energy is exactly the sum of p_i^2/(2m_i).
The finite kinetic energy is nonnegative.

capabilities.description: Minimal finite periodic lattice and constructor-locked deterministic strictly-positive mass realization.
laws: For [NeZero N], the periodic forward difference sums exactly to zero.
PositiveMassConfig has exactly the public mass field and its pointwise strict-positivity proof; its generated constructor is locked, and no random-mass probability law is asserted.
siteConfiguration_spec locks Site N exactly to ZMod N and Configuration N exactly to the real-valued field Site N → Real.

capabilities.description: A formula-locked diagnostic predicate that asserts neither ergodicity nor eventual occurrence.
laws: ApproxEquipartition is exactly the conjunction 0 ≤ mu < 1, T > 0, positive total averaged weight, and L1 distance to uniform at most delta.
For normalized nonnegative weights on a nonempty finite type, the L1 distance to uniform is at most two.
Uniform weights are exactly card^-1 and L1 distance is exactly the finite sum of absolute pointwise differences.

capabilities.description: Formula-locked generic finite observable normalization, independent of any occurrence claim.
laws: Under 0 ≤ mu < 1 and T > 0, pointwise nonnegative observables have nonnegative late-window averages; normalized-weight nonnegativity follows directly from the exact division formula, and the public sum theorem gives total one.
lateWindowAverage is exactly the normalized interval integral over [mu*T,T].
totalWeight is exactly the finite sum and normalizedWeights is exactly division by that total.

capabilities.description: Formula-locked finite entropy diagnostics with explicit simplex hypotheses and no thermalization conclusion.
laws: For nonnegative normalized weights, entropy lies between zero and log(card), and uniform weights attain log(card).
entropyDeficit is exactly log(card) minus entropy and participationNumber is exactly exp(entropy).
spectralEntropy is exactly the finite sum of Mathlib Real.negMulLog terms, including the total-at-zero convention.

capabilities.description: Formula-locked exact finite-dimensional Hamiltonian rescaling without a dynamical thermalization conclusion.
laws: For 3 ≤ n and epsilon > 0, scaling p and q by sqrt epsilon factors out epsilon and replaces lambda by the effective coupling; for nonzero lambda, its inverse-square identity is algebraic only.
The configuration rescaling is pointwise multiplication by sqrt epsilon, and the effective coupling is lambda times epsilon^((n-2)/2).
The finite Hamiltonian is formula-locked to the sum of kinetic, harmonic-difference, and degree-n interaction energy.

capabilities.description: Formula-locked finite Mathlib matrix realization of the mass-weighted harmonic operator.
laws: The periodic difference matrix acts as forwardDifference.
The resulting operator is positive semidefinite.
The weighted difference matrix is exactly the difference matrix times diagonal inverse square-root mass, and the harmonic matrix is B transpose times B.

capabilities.description: Formula-locked transparent finite normal modes; no localization or infinite-volume claim.
laws: Every exposed basis vector satisfies the operator eigen-equation and every frequency square is nonnegative.
Mode frequencies and the orthonormal mode basis are direct wrappers around Mathlib Hermitian spectral data.
The translation vector is exactly the pointwise square root of mass and is a nonzero zero mode.

capabilities.description: Formula-locked compatible first-hit scaling downstream of a proved effective-trajectory identity.
laws: For nonzero g and an explicitly transported trajectory, the state-event hitting time scales by the inverse of g².
The theorem operates on ENNReal infima and does not assume a hit is attained.
firstStateHittingTime is exactly the ENNReal infimum of strictly positive times whose toReal state satisfies the event.

capabilities.description: Explicit finite-N Hamiltonian dynamics, local solution-germ well-posedness, and conditional finite-interval conservation only.
laws: Along an explicit solution, Hamiltonian energy and total canonical momentum have zero derivative; endpoint equality is asserted only when the solution is defined throughout the unoriented interval between those endpoints.
For 1 ≤ n, the interaction force is the derivative of the polynomial bond potential occurring in the locked lattice Hamiltonian.
No global existence, maximal flow, microscopic-to-kinetic limit, equipartition, or thermalization conclusion is asserted.

PhaseSpace N is exactly the position-momentum product of two locked lattice configurations, and the microscopic vector field uses inverse-mass velocity together with the explicit periodic nearest-neighbour force.
The finite vector field is continuously differentiable, and every finite initial phase point admits a nontrivial local solution whose solution germ is unique.
